statement: NVIDIA reported record Q1 FY2027 Data Center revenue of $75.2 billion, up 92% year over year and 21% sequentially.
why: Data Center revenue is the most direct read on realised merchant-GPU demand and its sequential growth shows the buildout is still accelerating.

impact.mechanism: Record shipped data-center revenue pulls through HBM, advanced packaging and rack-scale networking content in proportion to accelerator volume.

evidence.excerpt: Record Data Center revenue of $75.2 billion, up 92% from a year ago

confidence.basis: Primary company earnings release with reported figures.
